constants_width_signedness_pointer_arith.scaling: Both maxima arrays contribute to max. For max>0, mul grows until max*mul>=height; if mul>1 it is decremented, otherwise div grows while max/div>height. Plotting uses data only: r.bottom-data[index]*mul when div==1, otherwise r.bottom-data[index]/div.
constants_width_signedness_pointer_arith.horizontal_coordinate: For n=1..63, x=n*width/64+slot+r.left. Original 0x04C6-0x04D8 computes signed truncation-toward-zero division by 64 through sign correction and SAR.
